description: Animal Science covers the care and management of livestock and poultry: breeds and their uses, disease prevention, nutrition, breeding and production technology, with hands-on work with one type of animal.

safety.note: Working with large animals requires supervision by an experienced adult.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. Requirement 6 offers options by species (beef, dairy, horse, sheep or goat, hog, or poultry) with their own steps; later requirements were not fully visible.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)
